是.pinyin: Bù wǒ bù shì nǐ cái shì
Zhè shì wǒ de mā ma

是.zh: 我不知道它是从哪里来的。
是.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào tā shì cóng nǎ lǐ lái de
是.en: I didn't know where it came from.
是.es: No sabía de dónde venía eso.

是.pinyin: Kě xī zhè shì zhēn de

北京.zh: 我是在北京学习中文的。
北京.pinyin: Wǒ shì zài běi jīng xué xí zhōng wén de

北京.zh: 我是在北京学习的中文。
北京.pinyin: Wǒ shì zài běi jīng xué xí de zhōng wén
北京.en: It was in Beijing that I studied Chinese.

北京.pinyin: Běi jīng shì zhōng guó de shǒu dū
北京.en: Beijing is the capital of China.
北京.es: Pekín es la capital de China.

北京.zh: 他跟我说了他明天从北京机场飞往英格兰。
北京.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ shuō le tā míng tiān cóng běi jīng jī chǎng fēi wǎng yīng gé lán
北京.en: He told me that tomorrow he goes from Beijing to England by plane.
北京.es: Él me dijo que mañana parte en avión de Pekín hacia Inglaterra.

小姐.pinyin: Xiǎo jie wǒ jué de bù shū fu

小姐.zh: 你应该知道不要问小姐的年龄。
小姐.pinyin: Nǐ yīng gāi zhī dào bù yào wèn xiǎo jie de nián líng
小姐.en: You should know better than to ask a lady her age.
小姐.es: Deberías saber que a una dama no se le pregunta la edad.

小姐.zh: 我能和布朗小姐说话吗？
小姐.pinyin: Wǒ néng hé bù lǎng xiǎo jie shuō huà ma
小姐.en: May I talk to Ms. Brown?

小姐.zh: 警察逮捕了谋杀这位小姐的凶手。
小姐.pinyin: Jǐng chá dài bǔ le móu shā zhè wèi xiǎo jie de xiōng shǒu
小姐.en: The police arrested the man who had murdered the girl.
小姐.es: La Policía arrestó al hombre que asesinó a la niña.

一点儿.pinyin: Wǒ yī diǎnr qián yě méi yǒu
Nǐ lèi ma bù yī diǎnr yě bù

一点儿.zh: 我会说一点儿苏格兰盖尔语。
一点儿.pinyin: Wǒ huì shuō yī diǎnr sū gé lán gài ěr yǔ
一点儿.en: I speak a little Scottish Gaelic.
一点儿.es: Hablo un poco de gaélico escocés.

一点儿.zh: 能听懂一点儿，但是不会讲。
一点儿.pinyin: Néng tīng dǒng yī diǎnr dàn shì bù huì jiǎng
一点儿.en: I understand it a little, but I can't speak it.
一点儿.es: Puedo entender un poco, pero no lo hablo.

累.pinyin: Nǐ lèi le bù shì ma
Wǒ gōng zuò lèi sǐ le

路.zh: 你可以走任何你喜欢的路。
路.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ zǒu rèn hé nǐ xǐ huan de lù
路.en: You can take whichever road you like.
路.es: Puedes seguir el camino que desees.

路.pinyin: Tā zài sēn lín zhōng mí le lù
路.en: He lost his way in the woods.

路.pinyin: Wáng zǐ zài sēn lín zhōng mí le lù
路.en: The prince was lost in the woods.
路.es: El príncipe estaba perdido en el bosque.

路.zh: 沿着这条路直走，到第三个红绿灯的地方右转。
路.pinyin: Yán zhe zhè tiáo lù zhí zǒu dào dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng de dì fang yòu zhuǎn
路.en: Go straight down this street and turn right at the third light.
路.es: Baje esta calle derecho y gire a la derecha en el tercer semáforo.

休息.pinyin: Nǐ bìng le gāi xiū xi le
休息.en: You're sick. You have to rest.

休息.pinyin: Wǒ néng xiū xi yī huìr ma
Wǒ men xiū xi yī xià ba hǎo ma
Tā xiū xi le yī huìr

哥哥.zh: 他是我哥哥，不是我爸爸。
哥哥.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ gē ge bù shì wǒ bà ba
哥哥.en: He is my brother, not my father.
哥哥.es: Él es mi hermano, no mi padre.

哥哥.zh: 在我十岁的时候，我哥哥离家出走了。
哥哥.pinyin: Zài wǒ shí suì de shí hou wǒ gē ge lí jiā chū zǒu le
哥哥.en: When I was 10, my brother left our home.
哥哥.es: Cuando yo tenía 10 años mi hermano se fue de casa.

哥哥.zh: 他哥哥是个有名的足球员。
哥哥.pinyin: Tā gē ge shì gè yǒu míng de zú qiú yuán
哥哥.en: His brother is a famous soccer player.
哥哥.es: Su hermano es un futbolista famoso.

哥哥.zh: 我哥哥已在伦敦住了很多年。
哥哥.pinyin: Wǒ gē ge yǐ zài lún dūn zhù le hěn duō nián
哥哥.en: My brother has been living in London for many years.
哥哥.es: Mi hermano lleva muchos años viviendo en Londres.

药.pinyin: Zhè yào zhì hǎo le wǒ de gǎn mào
药.en: This medicine cured me of my cold.

药.pinyin: Wǒ bèi pò chī le yào
药.en: I was forced to take medicine.
药.es: Me obligaron a que tomara la medicina.

药.zh: 我相信这种药对你的病情有帮助。
药.pinyin: Wǒ xiāng xìn zhè zhǒng yào duì nǐ de bìng qíng yǒu bāng zhù
药.en: I believe this type of medicine will help your illness.
药.es: Creo que esta medicina te hará efecto.

药.pinyin: Zhè yào duì nǐ yǒu hǎo chǔ
药.en: This medicine will do you good.

跳舞.pinyin: Qīn ài de wǒ men tiào wǔ ba

跳舞.zh: 为什么你不来跟我跳舞？
跳舞.pinyin: Wèi shén me nǐ bù lái gēn wǒ tiào wǔ
跳舞.en: Why don't you come dancing with me?
跳舞.es: ¿Por qué no venís a bailar conmigo?

跳舞.pinyin: Shéi jiāo nǐ tiào wǔ de
跳舞.en: Who taught you how to dance?

跳舞.pinyin: Nǐ yuàn yì hé wǒ tiào wǔ ma
跳舞.en: Would you like to dance with me?

灯.zh: 您介不介意我把灯关了？
灯.pinyin: Nín jiè bù jiè yì wǒ bǎ dēng guān le
灯.en: Do you mind if I turn off the light?

灯.zh: 他把一盏灯挂在了天花板上。
灯.pinyin: Tā bǎ yī zhǎn dēng guà zài le tiān huā bǎn shàng
灯.en: He hung a lamp from the ceiling.
灯.es: Él colgó una lámpara del techo.
De repente la luz se apagó.

情况.zh: 请写信告诉我你们学校的情况。
情况.pinyin: Qǐng xiě xìn gào su wǒ nǐ men xué xiào de qíng kuàng
情况.en: Please write to me about conditions at your school.
情况.es: Escríbeme, por favor, sobre la situación de tu colegio.

情况.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
情况.pinyin: Wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
情况.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
情况.es: En caso de emergencia, póngase en contacto con mi agente.

情况.zh: 在这种情况下，他们该做什么？
情况.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng xià tā men gāi zuò shén me
情况.en: What should they do in this situation?

情况.pinyin: Qíng kuàng yī tiān bǐ yī tiān chà
情况.en: The situation is getting worse and worse day by day.
情况.es: La situación empeora día a día.

价格.pinyin: Zhè ge jià gé hán le shuì
Shū cài de jià gé měi tiān zài biàn
价格.en: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.
价格.es: El precio de los vegetales cambia diariamente.

价格.pinyin: Zhè ge jià gé bù hé lǐ
Huáng jīn de jià gé měi tiān bō dòng
价格.en: The price of gold fluctuates daily.
价格.es: El precio del oro fluctúa diariamente.

厉害.pinyin: Wǒ jué de wǒ bìng de hěn lì hai
Wǒ shāo de hěn lì hai

厉害.zh: 我的手抖得太厉害，没法穿针了。
厉害.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒu dǒu de tài lì hai méi fǎ chuān zhēn le
厉害.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
厉害.es: Mis manos temblaban demasiado para enhebrar la aguja.

厉害.pinyin: Wǒ tóu tòng de lì hai
厉害.en: I'm suffering from a bad headache.
厉害.es: Estoy con un terrible dolor de cabeza.

感动.zh: 我们被她的故事深深的感动了。
感动.pinyin: Wǒ men bèi tā de gù shi shēn shēn de gǎn dòng le
感动.en: We were deeply moved by her story.
感动.es: Estábamos profundamente conmovidos por su historia.

感动.zh: 这件事让我真的很感动。
感动.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎn dòng
感动.en: I was really moved by this.

感动.es: Las canciones de amor me conmueven.

感动.zh: 他被那个故事深深地感动了。
感动.pinyin: Tā bèi nà ge gù shi shēn shēn de gǎn dòng le
感动.en: He was deeply moved by the story.

害羞.pinyin: Wǒ shì yī ge hài xiū de nán hái

害羞.zh: 我害羞得不敢正面看她的脸。
害羞.pinyin: Wǒ hài xiū de bù gǎn zhèng miàn kàn tā de liǎn
害羞.en: I was too shy to look her in the face.
害羞.es: Fui demasiado tímido como para mirarla a la cara.

害羞.zh: 对啊，她以前是一个很害羞的女孩。
害羞.pinyin: Duì a tā yǐ qián shì yī ge hěn hài xiū de nǚ hái
害羞.en: Yes. She used to be a very shy girl.
害羞.es: Sí, ella solía ser una niña muy tímida.

害羞.pinyin: Nǐ bù xū yào hài xiū
害羞.en: You have no need to be ashamed.

打扮.zh: 我不在乎别人怎么看我的打扮。
打扮.pinyin: Wǒ bù zài hu bié ren zěn me kàn wǒ de dǎ ban
打扮.en: I don't care what people think about the way I dress.
打扮.es: No me importa lo que la gente piense de cómo me visto.

打扮.zh: 为了她的重要约会，她精心打扮了一下。
打扮.pinyin: Wèi le tā de zhòng yào yuē huì tā jīng xīn dǎ ban le yī xià
打扮.en: She got all dolled up for her big date.
打扮.es: Se acicaló completamente para su gran cita.

打扮.pinyin: Tā dǎ ban de xiàng nǚ rén yī yàng
打扮.en: He dressed up as a woman.

打扮.zh: 她打扮得妖里妖气，一副傻样！
打扮.pinyin: Tā dǎ ban de yāo lǐ yāo qì yī fù shǎ yàng
打扮.en: She dresses so outrageously; it looks completely ridiculous!
打扮.es: Ella viste tan escandalosamente; ¡parece completamente ridícula!

民族.zh: 这是一片肥沃的土地，居住着不同的民族。
民族.pinyin: Zhè shì yī piàn féi wò de tǔ dì jū zhù zhe bù tóng de mín zú
民族.en: It's fertile land inhabited by diverse nations.

民族.zh: 世界上有很多不同的民族。
民族.pinyin: Shì jiè shàng yǒu hěn duō bù tóng de mín zú
民族.en: There are a lot of different peoples in the world.

民族.pinyin: Rì běn rén shì qín láo de mín zú
民族.en: The Japanese are an industrious people.

民族.zh: 我觉得不可以泛化一个民族，说日本人怎么样。
民族.pinyin: Wǒ jué de bù kě yǐ fàn huà yī ge mín zú shuō rì běn rén zěn me yàng
民族.en: I don't think that it is possible to generalise about a whole nation and say how all Japanese people are.

短信.zh: 汤姆给我发了一条有趣的短信。
短信.pinyin: Tāng mǔ gěi wǒ fā le yī tiáo yǒu qù de duǎn xìn
短信.en: Tom sent me an interesting text.
短信.es: Tom me mandó un mensaje interesante.

短信.zh: 不好意思，我必须回复短信。
短信.pinyin: Bù hǎo yì si wǒ bì xū huí fù duǎn xìn
短信.en: I'm sorry, I have to respond to the messages.
短信.es: Lo siento, tengo que responder a los mensajes.

短信.pinyin: Tā fā le yī tiáo duǎn xìn
Tāng mǔ shōu dào mǎ lì de duǎn xìn
短信.en: Tom got a message from Mary.

礼拜天.pinyin: Lǐ bài tiān wǒ qù jiāo huì
礼拜天.en: I go to the church on Sundays.
礼拜天.es: Voy a la iglesia los domingos.

礼拜天.zh: 上个礼拜天我刚好有空。
礼拜天.pinyin: Shàng ge lǐ bài tiān wǒ gāng hǎo yǒu kòng
礼拜天.en: It happened that I was free last Sunday.
礼拜天.es: De casualidad estaba yo libre el domingo pasado.

支.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ shì wǒ de

支.zh: 我昨天买了一支像你那样的笔。
支.pinyin: Wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī zhī xiàng nǐ nà yàng de bǐ
支.en: I bought a pen like yours yesterday.
支.es: Ayer compré un bolígrafo igual al tuyo.

支.zh: 如果你需要笔的话，我借你一支。
支.pinyin: Rú guǒ nǐ xū yào bǐ de huà wǒ jiè nǐ yī zhī
支.en: If you need a pen, I'll lend you one.
支.es: Si necesitas un lápiz, te lo dejo.

支.zh: 你想用这支笔，我就借给你吧。
支.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng yòng zhè zhī bǐ wǒ jiù jiè gěi nǐ ba
支.en: If you want this pen, I will lend it to you.
支.es: Si quieres este bolígrafo, te lo dejo.

唯一.zh: 我是唯一一个认识他们的人。
唯一.pinyin: Wǒ shì wéi yī yī ge rèn shi tā men de rén
唯一.en: I'm the only one who knows them.
唯一.es: Soy el único que los conoce.

唯一.zh: 我意识到这个可怕的地下室是唯一可以救我们命的地方。
唯一.pinyin: Wǒ yì shí dào zhè ge kě pà de dì xià shì shì wéi yī kě yǐ jiù wǒ men mìng de dì fang
唯一.en: I realized then that this awful cellar was the only place that could save our lives.
唯一.es: Me di cuenta en ese momento que este horrible sótano era el único lugar que nos podía salvar las vidas.

唯一.pinyin: Sǐ shì wéi yī de jiě tuō ma

唯一.zh: 一个差劲的厨师和下毒者唯一的不同在于他们的意图。
唯一.pinyin: Yī ge chà jìn de chú shī hé xià dú zhě wéi yī de bù tóng zài yú tā men de yì tú
唯一.en: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
唯一.es: La única diferencia entre una mala cocinera y una envenenadora es la intención.

离婚.zh: 我不知道他们是否会离婚。
离婚.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào tā men shì fǒu huì lí hūn
离婚.en: I wonder if they'll get divorced.
离婚.es: Me pregunto si se van a divorciar.

离婚.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tā huì hé tā lí hūn
离婚.en: I think she will divorce him.
离婚.es: Creo que se divorciará de él.

离婚.pinyin: Hěn yí hàn tā men lí hūn le
离婚.en: It's a pity they're getting divorced.
离婚.es: Es una lástima que se divorcien.

主人.zh: 你是这栋房子的主人吗？
主人.pinyin: Nǐ shì zhè dòng fáng zi de zhǔ rén ma
主人.en: Are you the owner of this house?

主人.pinyin: Shéi shì zhè jiān fáng zi de zhǔ rén
主人.en: Who is the owner of this house?
主人.es: ¿Quién es el dueño de esta casa?

主人.zh: 那只狗日复一日地等待着主人的归来。
主人.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu rì fù yī rì de děng dài zhe zhǔ rén de guī lái
主人.en: The dog waited day after day for its master's return.
主人.es: El perro esperaba día tras día el regreso de su amo.

主人.zh: 狗不安地看着他的主人。
主人.pinyin: Gǒu bù ān de kàn zhe tā de zhǔ rén
主人.en: The dog nervously looks at the master.

勇气.pinyin: Wǒ pèi fú nǐ de yǒng qì
勇气.en: I admire you for your courage.

勇气.pinyin: Wǒ pèi fú tā de yǒng qì
勇气.en: I admire him for his courage.

勇气.pinyin: Wǒ hěn pèi fú tā de yǒng qì

勇气.zh: 我对他的勇气感到惊讶。
勇气.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de yǒng qì gǎn dào jīng yà
勇气.en: I was amazed at his courage.

卧室.pinyin: Wǒ de wò shì lǐ méi yǒu zhuō zi
卧室.en: I don't have a desk in my bedroom.
卧室.es: No tengo escritorio en mi habitación.

卧室.zh: 我说过了，这是一个会议室，不是卧室。
卧室.pinyin: Wǒ shuō guo le zhè shì yī ge huì yì shì bù shì wò shì
卧室.en: I said that this was a meeting room, not a bedroom!
卧室.es: ¡Dije que esta es una sala de reuniones, no un dormitorio!

卧室.pinyin: Nǐ de wò shì lǐ méi yǒu rén
卧室.en: There's no one in your bedroom.
卧室.es: No hay nadie en tu habitación.

卧室.pinyin: Wǒ men jiā yǒu sān gè wò shì

价值.zh: 一辆车龄八年的车子几乎是毫无价值的。
价值.pinyin: Yī liàng chē líng bā nián de chē zi jī hū shì háo wú jià zhí de
价值.en: An eight-year-old car is almost worthless.
价值.es: Un coche de ocho años casi no tiene valor.

价值.pinyin: Nà bù diàn yǐng yǒu kàn de jià zhí
价值.es: Merece la pena ver esa película.

价值.zh: 我们不能高估健康的价值。
价值.pinyin: Wǒ men bù néng gāo gū jiàn kāng de jià zhí
价值.en: We cannot overestimate the value of health.

价值.zh: 这是一个具有历史价值的城市。
价值.pinyin: Zhè shì yī ge jù yǒu lì shǐ jià zhí de chéng shì
价值.en: This is a city of real historical value.

以来.zh: 我三天以来没吃一点东西。
以来.pinyin: Wǒ sān tiān yǐ lái méi chī yī diǎn dōng xi
以来.en: I have not eaten anything for the last three days.
以来.es: No he comido nada en los últimos tres días.

以来.zh: 本世纪初以来，产生了很多进步。
以来.pinyin: Běn shì jì chū yǐ lái chǎn shēng le hěn duō jìn bù
以来.en: Many improvements have been made since this century began.
以来.es: Se han hecho muchas mejoras desde que empezó este siglo.

以来.zh: 你跟你的女朋友见面以来有多久了？
以来.pinyin: Nǐ gēn nǐ de nǚ péng you jiàn miàn yǐ lái yǒu duō jiǔ le
以来.en: How long has it been since you saw your girlfriend?

以来.zh: 自从我开始学汉语以来已经有两年了。
以来.pinyin: Zì cóng wǒ kāi shǐ xué hàn yǔ yǐ lái yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng nián le
以来.en: It's been two years since I started learning Chinese.

嗯.zh: 嗯。。。我可以加入你的小组嘛
嗯.pinyin: Ēn wǒ kě yǐ jiā rù nǐ de xiǎo zǔ ma
嗯.en: Um... can we join your group?
嗯.es: Em... ¿nos podemos unir a su grupo?

嗯.zh: “我可不可以用你的笔？” “嗯，可以。”
嗯.pinyin: Wǒ kě bu kě yǐ yòng nǐ de bǐ ēn kě yǐ
嗯.en: "May I use this pencil?" "Yes, you may."

嗯.pinyin: Ēn dàn shì nǐ bì xū děng wǒ
嗯.en: Mmm, but you must wait for me.

牛仔裤.zh: 我从来没有看过他穿牛仔裤。

单位.en: Rice is sold by the kilogram.

改进.zh: 即使你受苦受难，一位好友还可以改进你的心情。

软.zh: 我住的那家旅馆的床太软了。

海鲜.en: If you like seafood, you've come to the right place!

接待.zh: 这次，虽然我的阅历更多但是没有人等着接待我。

接待.en: This time, although I'm more experienced, there's nobody waiting to meet me.

培养.zh: 培养政治意识要花费时间。
培养.pinyin: Péi yǎng zhèng zhì yì shí yào huā fèi shí jiān

培养.zh: 如果训练得当的话，音乐才能是可以培养出来的。

培养.en: Musical talent can be developed if it's properly trained.

培养.en: The raising of children is something that concerns the entire community. There will be an education reform.

补充.zh: 您对我说的话有什么要补充的吗？

补充.en: Would you like to add anything to what I've said?

补充.en: Please tell me what else I need to add.

补充.en: Is there anything you want to add to what I just said?

补充.zh: 听说适时地补充水分可以预防中暑。

盯.pinyin: Dīng zhe rén kàn shì bù lǐ mào de

盯.en: He's always looking at you. He must love you.
盯.es: Él siempre te está mirando. Debe quererte.

连衣裙.zh: 那条连衣裙真的很适合她。

发疯.en: When Dad finds out what you've done, he's going to hit the roof.

发疯.pinyin: Kàn tā de zhuàng tài kuài jìn yú fā fēng le

获胜.en: The important thing about the Olympic Games is not to win, but to take part in them.
获胜.es: Lo importante de los Juegos Olímpicos no es ganar, mas participar.

获胜.es: Lo más importante en los Juegos Olímpicos no es ganar, sino participar.

死人.zh: 我父母整天都在为鸡毛蒜皮的事情吵架，真是烦死人了！
死人.pinyin: Wǒ fù mǔ zhěng tiān dōu zài wèi jī máo suàn pí de shì qing chǎo jià zhēn shi fán sǐ rén le

死人.es: Mis padres siguen discutiendo por estupideces. ¡Es tan molesto!

死人.es: Se dice que Jesús levantó a un hombre de la muerte.

登出.pinyin: Wǒ bù yīng gāi dēng chū

登出.zh: 我会在八点钟的时候登出。
登出.pinyin: Wǒ huì zài bā diǎn zhōng de shí hou dēng chū
登出.en: I'm going to check out at eight.
登出.es: Voy a desocupar el cuarto a las ocho.

登出.zh: 登出后重新登入需要密码。
登出.pinyin: Dēng chū hòu chóng xīn dēng rù xū yào mì mǎ
登出.en: You need a password to log in again after logging out.
登出.es: Necesitas una contraseña para iniciar una nueva sesión después de cerrar una.

大雄.zh: 大雄那傢伙跑到哪里去了？
大雄.pinyin: Dà xióng nà jiā huo páo dào nǎ lǐ qù le
大雄.en: Where did that Daxiong run off to?

打碎.pinyin: Tāng mǔ dǎ suì le sān gè pán zi

打碎.zh: 他把杯子掉到地板上打碎了。
打碎.pinyin: Tā bǎ bēi zi diào dào dì bǎn shàng dǎ suì le
打碎.en: He dropped the cup and broke it.
打碎.es: Dejó caer la copa y se rompió.

打碎.zh: 请小心别打碎了这个花瓶。
打碎.pinyin: Qǐng xiǎo xīn bié dǎ suì le zhè ge huā píng
打碎.en: Please take care not to break this vase.
打碎.es: Ten cuidado de no romper esta jarra, por favor.

打碎.zh: 万一发生火灾，打碎玻璃并按下红色按钮。
打碎.pinyin: Wàn yī fā shēng huǒ zāi dǎ suì bō li bìng àn xià hóng sè àn niǔ
打碎.en: In case of fire, break the glass and push the red button.
打碎.es: En caso de incendio, rompa el vidrio y presione el botón rojo.

花儿.pinyin: Nà xiē huā ér ān wèi le tā
Nǐ mǎi le huā ér méi yǒu
Huā ér nǐ mǎi le méi yǒu

花儿.zh: 我把花儿放到花瓶里了。
花儿.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ huā ér fàng dào huā píng lǐ le
花儿.en: I put the flowers in the vase.

过头.zh: 今天的西蓝花做过头了，不是很好吃。
过头.pinyin: Jīn tiān de xī lán huā zuò guò tóu le bù shì hěn hǎo chī
过头.en: The broccoli is overcooked today — it's not very good.
过头.es: El brócoli de hoy está demasiado cocido y no está rico.

过头.zh: 你看起来很累。你一定是工作过头了。
过头.pinyin: Nǐ kàn qǐ lai hěn lèi nǐ yī dìng shì gōng zuò guò tóu le
过头.en: You look tired. You must have been working too hard.
过头.es: Pareces muy cansado. Debes haber estado trabajando demasiado duro.

过头.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hē guò tóu le

借用.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ jiè yòng nǐ de chē ma
Wǒ néng jiè yòng nǐ de jiǎn dāo ma

借用.zh: 你随时可以借用我的车。
借用.pinyin: Nǐ suí shí kě yǐ jiè yòng wǒ de chē
借用.en: You can borrow my car anytime.
借用.es: Usted puede tomar prestado mi coche en cualquier momento.

借用.zh: 我今天可以借用你的汽车吗?
借用.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān kě yǐ jiè yòng nǐ de qì chē ma
借用.en: May I use your car today?

弯.zh: 我不弯膝也能把手掌平放在地上。
弯.pinyin: Wǒ bù wān xī yě néng bǎ shǒu zhǎng píng fàng zài dì shàng
弯.en: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.
弯.es: Puedo poner las palmas de mis manos sobre el piso sin doblar las rodillas.

弯.zh: 她弯低身子，把钱币捡了起来。
弯.pinyin: Tā wān dī shēn zi bǎ qián bì jiǎn le qǐ lai
弯.en: She bent down and picked up the coin.
弯.es: Ella se agachó y recogió la moneda.

弯.pinyin: Wǒ men guǎi cuò wān le

弯.zh: 汤姆弯下腰，捧起了一把沙子。
弯.pinyin: Tāng mǔ wān xià yāo pěng qǐ le yī bǎ shā zi
弯.en: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.

扯.pinyin: Wǒ chě diào le zì jǐ de kù zi

扯.zh: 别再扯你姐姐的头发了！
扯.pinyin: Bié zài chě nǐ jiě jie de tóu fa le

扯.zh: 她在树枝上把自己的裙子扯烂了。
扯.pinyin: Tā zài shù zhī shàng bǎ zì jǐ de qún zi chě làn le
扯.en: She ripped her dress on a branch.

扯.zh: 这个男人简直像一台被扯掉了电源的肮脏电器。
扯.pinyin: Zhè ge nán rén jiǎn zhí xiàng yī tái bèi chě diào le diàn yuán de āng zāng diàn qì
扯.en: This man is like a filthy electronic without a battery.

清单.zh: 汤姆把他想去的地方列成了一张清单。
清单.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bǎ tā xiǎng qù de dì fang liè chéng le yī zhāng qīng dān
清单.en: Tom made a list of places he wants to visit.
清单.es: Tom hizo una lista de los lugares que quiere visitar.

清单.pinyin: Bāng wǒ zuò yī ge qīng dān

清单.zh: 她走过去看看她的名字是否在清单上。
清单.pinyin: Tā zǒu guò qù kàn kan tā de míng zi shì fǒu zài qīng dān shàng
清单.en: She went over the list to see if her name was there.

清单.zh: 我会将推荐的书目记在清单上，下次来图书馆时看。
清单.pinyin: Wǒ huì jiāng tuī jiàn de shū mù jì zài qīng dān shàng xià cì lái tú shū guǎn shí kàn
清单.en: I will note down the recommended bibliography on the list and look for them next time I come to the library.

南京.zh: 我们还没安排去南京的时间。
南京.pinyin: Wǒ men hái méi ān pái qù nán jīng de shí jiān
南京.en: We have not yet arranged the time to leave for Nanjing.

南京.zh: 如果我这点活儿可以做完，我将在星期一去南京。
南京.pinyin: Rú guǒ wǒ zhè diǎn huór kě yǐ zuò wán wǒ jiāng zài xīng qī yī qù nán jīng
南京.en: If I can finish up this bit of work, I will go to Nanjing on Monday.

南京.zh: 我出去玩都是在南京坐飞机，没去过上海。
南京.pinyin: Wǒ chū qù wán dōu shì zài nán jīng zuò fēi jī méi qù guo shàng hǎi
南京.en: When travelling, I always go to the airport in Nanjing, I've never been to Shanghai.

卡片.zh: 他送了一张卡片给玛丽。
卡片.pinyin: Tā sòng le yī zhāng kǎ piàn gěi mǎ lì
卡片.en: He sent a card to Mary.
卡片.es: Él le envió una tarjeta a Mary.

卡片.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī zhāng kǎ piàn
卡片.en: There is a card on the desk.
卡片.es: Hay una carta sobre el escritorio.

卡片.zh: 谢谢你寄给我的一张漂亮的卡片。
卡片.pinyin: Xiè xie nǐ jì gěi wǒ de yī zhāng piào liang de kǎ piàn
卡片.en: Thank you for sending me a nice card.

卡片.zh: 一张卡片被附在了礼物上。
卡片.pinyin: Yī zhāng kǎ piàn bèi fù zài le lǐ wù shàng
卡片.en: A card was attached to the gift.

打字机.pinyin: Wǒ de dǎ zì jī gù zhàng le
打字机.en: Something is wrong with my typewriter.
打字机.es: Algo anda mal con mi máquina de escribir.

打字机.pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ de dǎ zì jī ma

打字机.zh: 我的打字机好像有什么问题。

打字机.en: Something is wrong with my typewriter.
打字机.es: Algo anda mal con mi máquina de escribir.

积.pinyin: Gé lóu shàng jī le huī

积.pinyin: Bù jī xiǎo liú wú yǐ chéng jiāng hǎi
积.en: A pool begins with many drops of water.

吉米.pinyin: Děng yī xià wǒ qù jiào jí mǐ
吉米.en: Hang on a minute. I'll call Jimmy.
吉米.es: Espera un minuto, que llamo a Jimmy.

吉米.zh: 吉米坚持要我带他去动物园。
吉米.pinyin: Jí mǐ jiān chí yào wǒ dài tā qù dòng wù yuán
吉米.en: Jimmy insisted on my taking him to the zoo.
吉米.es: Jimmy insistió en que le llevara al zoo.

吉米.pinyin: Jí mǐ zhèng zài xiě xìn ma
Jí mǐ bǐ wǒ xiǎo liǎng suì
吉米.en: Jimmy is junior to me by two years.

术.pinyin: Nǐ shì gè zhú shì ma

术.zh: 她在夜校上自卫术课程。
术.pinyin: Tā zài yè xiào shàng zì wèi zhú kè chéng
术.en: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.
术.es: Ella tomó clases nocturnas de autodefensa.

术.zh: 汤姆的泳术比我们所有人都要好得多。
术.pinyin: Tāng mǔ de yǒng zhú bǐ wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu yào hǎo de duō
术.en: Of us all, Tom was by far the best swimmer.

术.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan tīng zhú lì kǒu yīn lè
术.en: I enjoy listening to vocaloid music.

火车票.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi huǒ chē piào le ba
火车票.en: You bought the ticket for the train?

火车票.zh: 今天夜晚去广州的火车票还有吗？
火车票.pinyin: Jīn tiān yè wǎn qù guǎng zhōu de huǒ chē piào hái yǒu ma
火车票.en: Are there any tickets left for a train to Guangzhou tonight?

火车票.zh: 过两天就可以在网上订火车票了。
火车票.pinyin: Guo liǎng tiān jiù kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng dìng huǒ chē piào le
火车票.en: The train tickets can be ordered online in a few days.

咯.zh: 所以我叫你不要一个人去咯。
咯.pinyin: Suǒ yǐ wǒ jiào nǐ bù yào yī gè rén qù gē
咯.en: That's why I'm telling you not to go alone.
咯.es: Por eso te estoy diciendo que no vayas solo.

咯.zh: 那你就是不懂这句句子咯？
咯.pinyin: Nà nǐ jiù shì bù dǒng zhè jù jù zi gē
咯.en: So you don't understand this sentence?

咯.pinyin: Jīn wǎn jiàn ba yī huìr jiàn gē
咯.en: See you tonight! See you soon!

唯.pinyin: Rén jiē yǒu cuò wéi shèng zhě néng shù
唯.en: To err is human, to forgive divine.

唯.pinyin: Tiān shàng tiān xià wéi wǒ dú zūn
唯.en: Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one.

唯.zh: 这些话，他听过不止一次，唯其不止一次，才忍无可忍。

唯.en: He’d heard this more than once, but once was once more than he could bear.

法庭.zh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
法庭.pinyin: Fǎ tíng duì tā de móu shā zuì míng zuò chū le wú zuì pàn jué
法庭.en: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.
法庭.es: La corte lo declaró inocente de los cargos de homicidio.

法庭.zh: 被告周五将会出现在法庭上。
法庭.pinyin: Bèi gào zhōu wǔ jiāng huì chū xiàn zài fǎ tíng shàng
法庭.en: The accused is to appear before the court on Friday.
法庭.es: El acusado debe aparecer ante la corte el día viernes.

法庭.zh: 设立「普丁法庭」的程序已经启动。
法庭.pinyin: Shè lì pǔ dīng fǎ tíng de chéng xù yǐ jīng qǐ dòng
法庭.en: The process of creating a “tribunal for Putin” has been launched.

法庭.pinyin: Fǎ tíng xuān pàn bèi gào wú zuì
法庭.en: The court declared the defendant innocent.

白费.zh: 我们所有的努力都白费了。
白费.pinyin: Wǒ men suǒ yǒu de nǔ lì dōu bái fèi le

白费.es: Todos nuestros esfuerzos fueron en vano.

白费.pinyin: Tā men de nǔ lì dōu bái fèi le
白费.en: All their efforts were in vain.
白费.es: Todos sus esfuerzos fueron en vano.

白费.pinyin: Nǐ bái fèi lì qi le
白费.en: You're barking up the wrong tree.
白费.es: Le estás ladrando al árbol equivocado.

白费.zh: 我想解决这个问题，可是白费功夫。
白费.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiě jué zhè ge wèn tí kě shì bái fèi gōng fu
白费.en: I tried in vain to deal with the problem.
白费.es: Intenté en vano ocuparme del problema.

网路.zh: 我的网路连线被切断了。
网路.pinyin: Wǒ de wǎng lù lián xiàn bèi qiē duàn le
网路.en: My internet connection was cut off.
网路.es: Me cortaron la conexión a Internet.

网路.zh: 许多网路公司为求生存而需要新颖的商业模式。
网路.pinyin: Xǔ duō wǎng lù gōng sī wèi qiú shēng cún ér xū yào xīn yǐng de shāng yè mó shì
网路.en: Many on-line companies need to have a new approach to business to survive.
网路.es: Muchas compañías en internet necesitan tener un nuevo enfoque para que las empresas sobrevivan.

网路.zh: 不是所有的网路浏览器都是安全的。
网路.pinyin: Bù shì suǒ yǒu de wǎng lù liú lǎn qì dōu shì ān quán de
网路.en: Not all internet browsers are safe.

肉体.pinyin: Líng hún shì ròu tǐ de jiān láo
肉体.en: The soul is the prison of the body.
肉体.es: El alma es la prisión del cuerpo.

肉体.pinyin: Ròu tǐ zhōng yǒu yī sǐ

肉体.zh: 移民们忍受着肉体和精神的痛苦。
肉体.pinyin: Yí mín men rěn shòu zhe ròu tǐ hé jīng shén de tòng kǔ
肉体.en: The emigrants have endured physical and mental pain.

肉体.pinyin: Líng hún fù yǔ ròu tǐ shēng mìng

诗歌.zh: 跨行是指一句话在诗歌中从一行跨到下一行的情况。
诗歌.pinyin: Kuà xíng shì zhǐ yī jù huà zài shī gē zhōng cóng yī xíng kuà dào xià yī xíng de qíng kuàng
诗歌.en: Enjambment is when a sentence from one line of poetry spills over into the next line.

诗歌.zh: 中国诗歌以李白的诗最为有名。
诗歌.pinyin: Zhōng guó shī gē yǐ lǐ bái de shī zuì wéi yǒu míng
诗歌.en: Li Bai's work is the most famous of Chinese poetry.

诗歌.zh: 比起小说，他更喜欢诗歌。
诗歌.pinyin: Bǐ qǐ xiǎo shuō tā gèng xǐ huan shī gē

过年.zh: 过年时，小刘的单位给每位员工发一袋面粉。
过年.pinyin: Guò nián shí xiǎo liú de dān wèi gěi měi wèi yuán gōng fā yī dài miàn fěn
过年.en: For the new year, Liu's company gives every employee a bag of flour.
过年.es: En el Año Nuevo, la compañía de Liu regala a cada empleado una bolsa de harina.

过年.pinyin: Míng tiān jiù yào guò nián le
过年.en: Tomorrow is the start of the new year.

过年.zh: 过年过节时，他总是来慰劳。
过年.pinyin: Guò nián guò jié shí tā zǒng shì lái wèi láo
过年.en: He always comes to show his appreciation during the New Year and holidays.

过年.pinyin: Qìng zhù chūn jié sú chēng guò nián
过年.en: Celebrating Spring Festival is commonly referred to as 'passing the year'.

长相.zh: 我记得他的长相但忘了他叫甚么名字。
长相.pinyin: Wǒ jì de tā de zhǎng xiàng dàn wàng le tā jiào shèn má míng zi
长相.en: I remember his face but I can't remember his name.
长相.es: Recuerdo su cara pero no recuerdo su nombre.

长相.pinyin: Tā de zhǎng xiàng yǔ nián líng bù fú
长相.es: Él no luce de esa edad.

长相.zh: 只凭长相的话很难区分英国人和美国人。
长相.pinyin: Zhǐ píng zhǎng xiàng de huà hěn nán qū fēn yīng guó rén hé měi guó rén
长相.en: It's hard to tell Englishmen from Americans just by the way they look.
长相.es: Es difícil diferenciar a un inglés de un estadounidense solo por su apariencia.

食用.zh: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。
